be374dadf64545617688.en: Animals have different body parts. These parts help them live.
be374dadf64545617688.id: Hewan punya bagian tubuh yang berbeda-beda. Bagian-bagian ini membantu mereka hidup.

fd23ba407f28b31cbca4.en: Birds have feathers, wings and a beak. Most birds can fly.
fd23ba407f28b31cbca4.id: Burung punya bulu (feathers), sayap (wings), dan paruh (beak). Kebanyakan burung bisa terbang.

87b4a8e0af2425d7880f.en: Fish have fins and scales. They swim in water.
87b4a8e0af2425d7880f.id: Ikan punya sirip (fins) dan sisik (scales). Ikan berenang di air.

efcda87a5a4e7d4e0ccc.en: Many animals have fur. Cats, rabbits and monkeys have fur.
efcda87a5a4e7d4e0ccc.id: Banyak hewan punya bulu (fur). Kucing, kelinci, dan monyet punya bulu.

c418e576eeb1aae4b9b7.en: We can sort animals by their legs. Insects have 6 legs and spiders have 8.
c418e576eeb1aae4b9b7.id: Kita bisa mengelompokkan hewan menurut kakinya. Serangga punya 6 kaki dan laba-laba punya 8.
